tiers.tutorial: Always plays, once, the first time the condition happens.
tiers.story: Always plays, once. Never suppressed by the cooldown.
tiers.flavour: Optional. Only plays if no bark of any tier played in the last 120 s, and at most 1 per 180 s. Repeating triggers (loot, idle, low_health, new_monster, secret_wall, deep_water, leech_latch) pick a random line not used yet, then stop once their pool is spent.

first_sight: first_sight_<monster> is story tier: one random line from its pool, once per save, the first time that monster type is in view. When it fires, new_monster is suppressed for that sighting; new_monster only covers types with no first_sight_ lines (slime, cellar_spider, tide_spawn, captain_dural).
condition: A line may carry condition {flag: value}. Only lines whose flags match the save are eligible (unset counts as false).
act: A line with act: N is ignored before act N (torch_draws_monster is act 2).
puzzle_barks: Barks under <puzzle>.barks in story/puzzles_act1.json use the same tiers and must be merged with barks.json by the loader.
